Mikaela Torres: Hey everyone :wave: I’m Mikaela — just finished my first two days and officially claimed Desk 4F-22 (tiny victory). I brought a pothos and a sad fortune cookie that said ‘You will become a plant parent’ so... mission accomplished :seedling:
Avery: welcome!! :tada: plant pics pls :eyes:
Mikaela Torres: attaching a horrible phone pic in #photos-channel in a sec, it’s leaning already lol. Quick Q — where is the good coffee? the office drip is... nostalgic :coffee:
Sam: the espresso in the kitchenette on 4 is the secret weapon. also we have a pour-over kit in the lounge if you want slow-brew zen :slightly_smiling_face:
Noor: also coffee chat at 3pm near the whiteboard — newbies usually show up, come by if you can :handshake:
Mikaela Torres: I’ll pop by! also does anyone know if we still do the desk-fort lunchtime build? i have extra cardboard and tape and low standards for engineering feats :smile_cat:
Arjun: yes! monthly fort build is very much alive. we’re doing a tiny hackathon-ish demo on Friday, so come practice your structural engineering :hammer_and_wrench:
Juniper (HR bot): Welcome Mikaela! Your onboarding buddy is Arjun. Don’t forget to claim your benefits checklist and RSVP for the Welcome Lunch on Friday :plate_with_cutlery:
People Ops: Welcome!! We already put a small plant stipend on your profile. If you need a monitor arm or more plants, ping us. Also ping @Noor for lunch logistics :heart:
Mikaela Torres: omg plant stipend, you all are too kind. thanks everyone — excited to be here. I’ll be in #random with the plant pics and in person at 3pm :seedling::coffee:
